problem_text:
A network of data centers must allocate computational workloads across several cloud service regions to minimize total processing latency.

The available processing capacity at each data center (set C) is as follows:
*C1's capacity is 106.
*C2's capacity is 55.
*C3's capacity is 184.
*C4's capacity is 172.
*C5's capacity is 50.
*C6's capacity is 134.
*C7's capacity is 101.
*C8's capacity is 83.
*C9's capacity is 137.

The required computational load that must be satisfied at each service region (set R) is specified below:
*R1's load is 132.
*R2's load is 121.
*R3's load is 47.
*R4's load is 4.
*R5's load is 83.
*R6's load is 130.
*R7's load is 110.
*R8's load is 120.
*R9's load is 122.

The unit latency cost for processing a workload unit from each data center to each region is provided in the following matrix:
| From / To | R1 | R2 | R3 | R4 | R5 | R6 | R7 | R8 | R9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| C1 | 3 | 12 | 13 | 19 | 4 | 11 | 10 | 11 | 5 |
| C2 | 6 | 14 | 16 | 11 | 6 | 18 | 20 | 12 | 8 |
| C3 | 19 | 6 | 13 | 10 | 10 | 5 | 6 | 1 | 19 |
| C4 | 13 | 19 | 2 | 6 | 20 | 11 | 20 | 8 | 19 |
| C5 | 4 | 16 | 5 | 11 | 3 | 8 | 12 | 11 | 6 |
| C6 | 3 | 11 | 15 | 1 | 9 | 7 | 8 | 3 | 12 |
| C7 | 9 | 4 | 1 | 2 | 13 | 15 | 14 | 6 | 14 |
| C8 | 16 | 13 | 12 | 18 | 13 | 4 | 16 | 19 | 8 |
| C9 | 6 | 15 | 3 | 2 | 10 | 1 | 11 | 9 | 4 |

Determine the optimal allocation of workloads to minimize the aggregate latency cost.
